description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log utility. It forwards log messages and supports chaining of multiple LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's Log utility and supports chaining for log output.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specific priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then forwards the log to the next node.
